text.tspan: Representative sparse layer with a full DSA indexer (for example, layer 7 of 78, 1-based); batch size fixed at 1
Module paths are relative to model.layers.<layer_idx> unless prefixed with model.
X_l and X_(l+1) have the same shape so layers compose directly.
They are not the same values: attention, MoE transformations, and residual additions update the tensor.

g.text: A. DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) + Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)
Architecture source: zai-org/GLM-5.2 config.json and Hugging Face Transformers GlmMoeDsa implementation (accessed 2026-08-21).

text.tspan: theta = 8,000,000; apply to Q_RoPE and shared K_RoPE
receive top-k indices from the previous
Attend only to selected causal K/V positions
Layers 4-78 use this MoE FFN (75 layers)
Normalize 8 gathered scores to sum to 1
Dispatch each token to its 8 selected experts

g.text: mlp.experts: GlmMoeDsaExperts; 256 routed experts, execute 8 per token

text.tspan: Multiply each expert output by its token/expert weight
